summary: Gain Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events to announce a press release and shareholder letter stating its cash equivalents will fund operations into Q2 2027, including completion of a Phase 1b open-label extension and initiation of a Phase 2 study. The filing does not disclose any specific terms regarding a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring; it is an ordinary business update on cash runway and clinical timelines. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are mentioned. This is a routine current report, not a special situation.
